criteria.requirement: Implement xlsxwriter.report.export_report(destination,columns,records,*,sheet="Report",max_rows=1048576,workbook_options=None) and frozen ReportSummary(sheets,row_count). Reuse completed atomic_workbook, safe sheet naming and typed write_records. Stream records once, split at explicit per-sheet row budget including repeated headers, freeze first row, create one header-only sheet for empty input and return actual names/count only after successful replacement. Preserve UTC and literal-formula semantics in constant_memory mode. Any bad later record or source exception preserves the old target without partial report files. Validate budgets/schema before iterating.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
